name: v1.7.0 Release
body:
**Changelog:**
- fixed an error on startup under wayland on GNOME 40 (see issue #18)
- added a restart prompt to the theme selection (see issue #23)
- added option to restore backups on android (see issue #16)
- made application font size adjustable in settings
- multi identity support on android and macOS
Note: Multi-identity support on Android and macOS has been achieved by adding an option in the settings to prompt on startup for an identity to start with.
- reduced application size (~30MB)
- added release for each android architecture (+universal)

name: v1.7.0 Pre-Release
body:
**Changelog:**

- Added Android version
- Added group chats (group hosting for now on desktop versions only).
- Changed the image sending to a dialog with the option to add a caption.
- Emojis are now rendered as pictures (on all platforms, the same emojis).
- Support for multiple emoji fonts (noto, twemoji, emojitwo)
- Fixed a bug that ticking custom background setting also disables the theme selection.
- Fixed potential crash when closing the chat window right after sending a message.
- Fixed crash when trying to add a bridge.
- Speek IDs can now be scanned via a QR-Code.
- Allow to specify a config path when launching Speek (see issue #11).
- Multiple UI tweaks and improvements

**Notes:**

- The Linux Appimage is bigger to ensure compatibility with most (old and new) Linux versions.
- The newest release is also available on the [Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.speek.chat).
- The Android APK is compatible with every architecture (arm, arm64, x86, x86_64).

name: v1.6.1 Pre-Release
body:
Changelog:
This pre-release only fixes the bug mentioned in #3 and #7. Updating is not required if you are currently not experiencing that UI issue.

**Changelog:**

- Added dialog for all received contact requests (replaces the intrusive contact request popup - instead a notification is shown in the application)
- Smoother profile picture circle
- Systemtray notification on new contact request
- Custom theme support
- Contact list is now resizeable
- Changed notification sound
- Added some tooltips
- Fixed that closing the first-launch dialog and restarting the app will cause Speek to never connect to the network
- Increased font size on MacOS
- Default theme now dark-blue
- Improved input validation
- Multiple UI tweaks and improvements
- Fixed that the unread messages count badge is not always showing up

**Notes:**
- The Linux Appimage is bigger to ensure compatibility with most (old and new) linux versions.
- The Windows Installer is compatible with Windows 7, 8 and 10
- The newest release is also within a few days available on the [MacOS Appstore](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/speek/id1609665326) and [Microsoft Store](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/speek/9plhbg7k1wzn?activetab=pivot:overviewtab)

**Changelog:**

- Added option to export identity backup
- Option to send multiple files or folders as zip archive
- Updated Icons
- Fixed font size issue
- System tray support
- Default resize images when sending
- Fixed textinput validation
- Fixed text selection highlighting
- Various Ui Fixes (Settings etc.)

**Notes:**
- The Linux Appimage is bigger to ensure compatibility with most (old and new) linux versions.
- The Windows Installer is compatible with Windows 7, 8 and 10
- The newest release is also available on the [Microsoft Store](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/speek/9plhbg7k1wzn?activetab=pivot:overviewtab)

name: Speek.Chat 1.4.3
body:
**Changelog:**

- Mayor ui overhaul
- Fixed crash when deleting a user that hasn't accepted the contact request
- Added image viewer
- Added contact search
- Added dialog to create multiple identities
- Custom chat area background
- Fixed Emoji Scolling
- Added option to reject contact request without blocking user
- Light mode tweaks
- various windows fixes
- various other minor fixes

Note: The Appimage is bigger to ensure compatibility with most (old and new) linux versions.
